subject: New paper using Stan and WAIC

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: New paper using Stan and WAIC
parts:
Hi,

I would like to share with you that my colleagues and I used Stan and WAIC for our new paper and here are its citation and a link to the paper:

Ahn W-Y, Vasilev G, Lee S-H, Busemeyer JR, Kruschke JK, Bechara A and Vassileva J (2014) Decision-making in stimulant and opiate addicts in protracted abstinence: evidence from computational modeling with pure users. Front. Psychol. 5:849. doi: 10.3389/fpsyg.2014.00849

http://journal.frontiersin.org/Journal/10.3389/fpsyg.2014.00849/abstract

Thanks a lot for the great software and your papers describing how to implement WAIC. There are more papers on the way out that also use Stan and WAIC, and they could have been possible thanks to the Stan team!

Best,
Young

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] New paper using Stan and WAIC

Thanks. I added it to our publication list.

- Bob
